resolution: Implemented host-native modelview safety guards and edge topology tools: gizmo drags now snapshot mesh positions, detect collapsed/flipped triangle edits on release, and surface Split Quads / Ignore / Revert in the cart; edge mode now supports deterministic edge selection, extrude-one-edge, and create-face from two disjoint edges or closed 3/4-edge loops, remounting a new retained host mesh key while carrying paint colors/source geometry forward. Verified with zig build test-mesh-edit, zig build test-model-paint, SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship modelview, plus headless shots shots/edge_extrude.png and shots/edge_create_face.png.
